transcript: I ranked them this way because I think the moral commonwealth, somebody's inner morality, needs to come first. Being able to always do the right thing no matter what. Secondly, I chose the institutional utopia because, of course, we always have to have rules, laws, and regulations. Because even though we have inner morality, not everybody does the right thing. And there has to be consequences to doing the wrong thing.
